title: hushrun.run-result/v0
description: One run of `hushrun run NAME -- COMMAND`, or one skip, as a results backend keeps it (spec C-12): in a directory, results/v0/<key>/<ULID>.json, or skips/v0/<key>/<ULID>.json for a skip; on a server, the body of POST {base}/v0/results/{key}. Readers ignore fields they don't know.

result.description: pass: COMMAND exited 0; fail: it exited with another code; skip: it didn't run, because a pass for the same key stood in for it.

exitCode.description: COMMAND's exit code; null for a skip.

command.description: COMMAND, one string per argument, as given. [ADR 0050] A secret in it is [redacted] (spec C-10); the key holds COMMAND as given (spec C-9).

cwd.description: The directory COMMAND ran in, relative to the repository root, /-separated: empty at the root.

digest.description: The scope's source digest (spec §4): the code the run was on.

external.description: [ADR 0037] What the scope declares outside the repository (spec C-4), each digested from its worktree, by path: part of the key (spec C-9). Left out when the scope declares none.

revision.description: The commit checked out, when there was one. It informs; the digest decides.

repository.description: host/owner/name: the CI provider's, else hushrun.yaml's `repository`, else the `origin` remote's. It informs.

durationMs.description: How long COMMAND ran; for a skip, how long hushrun took.

savedMs.description: A skip's only: how long the run it stood in for took, that pass's durationMs.

provider.description: Where it ran: local, or the CI provider.

job.description: [ADR 0044] The CI job that ran it and the system it ran on, <job>@<platform>, such as unit@linux/amd64, which decides whose runs its pass stands in for (spec C-10). <job> is GITHUB_JOB on GitHub Actions and CI_JOB_NAME on GitLab CI; <platform> is written as E-7 writes it. Left out outside CI, and where CI names none.

variant.description: [ADR 0049] Which variant of its job the run was, when the job has several and says which (HUSHRUN_VARIANT, spec C-14): `key`, the sha256 of the variant's values as JCS writes them, which a lookup asks for (spec C-10), and `label`, its values in key order for people to read. Only that variant's passes stand in for its runs. Left out of a run in a job without variants.

tool.description: The hushrun that recorded it, such as "hushrun 0.1.0".

invokedBy.description: Who ran it, from HUSHRUN_INVOKED_BY: agent:<id> or human:<id>. A label that tells a fleet's runs apart when they share a token (ADR 0027). It informs.

environment.description: [ADR 0045] Where it ran, in the shape of spec E-7: `platform`, such as linux/arm64, and `tools`, the version of each tool a counts_from rule made hushrun measure (spec C-25), by the name the rule gives it. A skip measures nothing. It informs: only the key decides, and it is the machine's own word. Left out of results from before it.

reports.description: [ADR 0048] The summary of the test and coverage reports the run wrote (spec C-27): counts, and each file's path and format, never a test's name, a message or a file's contents; at most 4,096 bytes as JSON. A skip's is the one of the pass it stood in for. Left out when the search went past its bounds or read none of what it found; only `filesComplete` when it found none. Readers ignore fields they don't know in it.

files.description: The report files read, at most 16, by path from the repository root, /-separated, each at most 160 bytes; left out when none fits.

format.description: junit, trx, lcov, cobertura, jacoco, clover, opencover, go, coveragepy, istanbul or simplecov; another word from a newer hushrun.

filesLeftOut.description: The report files read that `files` leaves out; left out when none is.

filesComplete.description: [ADR 0048] `files` names every report file the search found, each read, and the search went everywhere the job's readers read (spec C-26, C-27); left out otherwise.

tests.description: When a test-results file was read: its tests, `failed` and `errors` apart, and how long they took when the files say.

coverage.description: When a coverage file was read: its format, and the lines (statements, for Go's) and branches it covered, each left out when it counts nothing.

ranAnyway.description: Why it ran although a pass of its key would have skipped it: the one rule that stopped the skip. variants: its job has several variants, and the run doesn't say which it is (ADR 0044, 0049); reusable: its job may be a called workflow's, and the run can't tell which (ADR 0049); reports: a later step of the job reads the check's reports, which a skip doesn't write (ADR 0047, spec C-26); rule: the pass doesn't count in this job, as another job's, another variant's, or one from outside CI in a job with variants (spec C-10); force: `--force`; inside-run: it ran inside another run, in a job with several variants (ADR 0044); cant-tell: hushrun can't read the job. Left out when the run found no such pass, and of a skip. A newer hushrun may say another word: a reader takes it as one more rule.

units.description: [ADR 0068] The run's test files, when its check's `tests` aren't off and an adapter reported them (spec C-10, C-32): how many it collected, ran and reused, and [ADR 0069] why none was reused when something stopped all reuse (C-34), and [ADR 0074] in a run that reused some, how long they took when they last ran (`savedMs`).
